.github/workflows/acceptance.yml does not exist at 33968c92 — it was first added at b032d1a3 on 2026-09-22T07:26:33Z.
Neither a push of this SHA nor workflow_dispatch against it can therefore trigger a run.

why_not_grafted: Cherry-picking the CI harness onto 33968c92 would produce a different SHA with a different tree, and the resulting green badge would describe that graft rather than the V0.5 candidate. The provenance script exists precisely to prevent evidence floating free of the commit it describes, so the gates were run against the real tree instead.
